headline: Congress essentially takes the week off—both chambers convening in pro forma sessions Friday with no committee action scheduled.

senate.lastSessionSummary: The Senate met briefly in pro forma session on October 6 and immediately adjourned until Friday. Pro forma sessions are minimal procedural meetings with no legislative business conducted.

house.lastSessionSummary: The House met at 4 p.m. on October 6 and adjourned at 4:02 p.m. Seventeen public bills and five resolutions were introduced, and two veterans affairs-related bills were reported out of committee.

onTheFloor.title: Requires the Board of Veterans' Appeals to identify factors contributing to untimely disposition and remand of appeals in its annual report
Requires the Secretary of Veterans Affairs to submit annual reports on the National Cemetery Administration
